Name: (MYC) Seeds and Crops
Author: PrinceAstero
Description:
This is a config addon for the [i][b]MultYieldCrops[/b][/i] mod, which adds the chance to harvest more and receive seeds. It is highly configurable.

[u]HarvestRules.json [/u]file is configured for vanilla crops, both harvest and seed, in the proportions:

From 0 to up to two items:
“minHarvest”: [color=red][b]0[/b][/color], //requires integer value
“maxHarvest”: [color=red][b]2[/b][/color], //requires integer value

No increment by farming level: “maxHarvestIncreasePerFarmingLevel” : [color=red][b]0.0[/b][/color],

Just change the [color=red][b]RED[/b][/color] numbers to the amount you want.
[u]Working in Android.[/u]

Instructions:
> Make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI;
> Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6069]MYC[/url] and follow instructions;
> Download this mod and unzip into your /mods folder.

[b]Thanks[/b]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3590100][b] CherryChain[/b][/url].
Thanks for the mod, it has helped me a lot to understand about Json.


(It's my first "mod" and English is not my native language)
